download.request: BrowserDownloadRequest with SessionID, TabID, ResourceURI, optional filename
download.result: BrowserDownloadResult with ResourceURI (NOT physical path), filename, sizeBytes, contentType
download.note: Download destination follows B14_input_manifest: amitia://workspace/downloads/... or amitia://attachments/...

upload.request: BrowserUploadRequest with SessionID, TabID, ResourceURI (NOT physical path), optional targetInput
upload.result: BrowserUploadResult with ResourceURI and Success flag
upload.note: Upload source uses resourceuri.Parse + PhysicalResolver.Resolve internally

screenshot.request: BrowserScreenshotRequest with SessionID, TabID, optional format/quality
screenshot.result: BrowserScreenshotResult with ResourceURI pointing to amitia://temp/screenshots/...
